items.summary: Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks are evidenced closed; all 4 remain open. Existing progress is limited to official Woot documentation review, partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use disposition: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional where it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Fleet compliance is a technical baseline, not legal certification: 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 are unknown; open findings include banner, consent accept/reject, GA4, privacy, and terms checks. Do not block ordinary reversible growth solely for incomplete telemetry, but keep public exposure and security-sensitive releases blocked where compliance, security, rights, or launch evidence is missing. Revenue remains limited to the 2026-09-21 aggregate Amazon result: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, not assignable to sites; do not claim ROI, margin, or causal lift.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blockers.
